opps.title: 2 accounts holding all year but soft this month — 1,900 cases behind

That is the pattern that becomes a bad quarter if nobody catches it, and it is the cheapest kind to fix: the account is still buying, it just has not placed its usual order yet. Together they are 1,900 cases and about $1,900 of commission behind last August's pace, with days left in the month to close it.
